high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a social media post from the New Scientist account on Instagram. The post features an article title that reads: "Nerve fibres in the brain could generate quantum entanglement." Below the title, there is a colorful illustration of neural pathways in the brain, depicted with various colors such as green, blue, red, and pink, against a black background. This visual representation emphasizes the intricate network of nerve fibers. The text accompanying the image states: "Nerve fibres in the brain could produce pairs of particles linked by quantum entanglement.
